title: No more UAM ??
body:

Running last dev. Logs if they can help.

Another case. Classic dinner, 45g carbs, a bit fatty compared to usual. Hypo before going to bed. I eat biscuits and maple syrup but don't tell those carbs to AAPS.

Sorry but I can't test. I only keep the last and the one before last apks. I have total confidence in the _boss_ for never needing to go back several versions 😉
I confirm I still have yellow bars on mý dev phone synchronized with latest dev branch (data 100% synchronized with my loop phone).

Yellow UAM bars come from autosens plugin, so some options:
- You changed autosens plugin to (older) version without UAM
- Autosens is disabled? idk mostly it should show up, but I'm not on dev so don't know the exact behavoir there
- Autosens UAM detection is generally: IOB > (2x basal), so maybe you changed your basal profile and this condition is not met

Thanks for the AutoSens tip. It was turned OFF. 

![Screenshot_20250813_143221_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/875c65ca-2a6a-41a2-b3dd-508f622f8a9e)

This problem is still not solved. Look around 1AM. IOB is over 5 times my profile basal and not a single yellow UAM bar. UAM is checked in settings of course.

Q: Could this be an AutoISF problem?

(Not using UAM and/or AutoISF: both do not work for me. Will see if I can repro this issue)

I looked at the charts only. Didn't search in the loop run data.

I thought a "bad option setting" in memory. UAM was checked in settings. I unchecked, force closed, delete cache, restart, check UAM, force close, delete cache, restart. Same result. No UAM bars.

UAM is interesting to use as it gives more power to SMBs (if you setup more basal minutes to SMBs with UAM).

No idea why I have not a single yellow bars (for months now).

> .. No idea why I have not a single yellow bars (for months now).

I do have yellow bars now and then but nu UAM active.
Need to check again on the yellow bars ;-) and maybe also test UAM. Testing DASH atm (PR4499)

Issue probably solved. If you use _AAPS sensibility_, you loose UAM. Using Oref1 sensitivity brings back the UAM.

I set Oret1 and and am waiting for the next BG raise with COB = 0

Can't understand why AAPS sensitivity zaps the UAM...
